facts.fact: OBS-CC says Douala hosted the ECCAS regional workshop on a common framework for cross-border data governance from 31 August to 4 September 2026.
facts.system: ECCAS regional workshop on cross-border data governance

facts.fact: OBS-CC says that in September 2025 the UN Economic Commission for Africa and ECCAS validated in Douala a regional digital trade policy with an action plan for 2025-2030 and a framework law.
